findings.statement: Convergence rank 1 (score 4.5197, 5 streams). Open Targets association score 0.3088, rank 79 of 1998. Tractability: AB Advanced Clinical, SM Approved Drug. Drugs: GIRENTUXIMAB PHASE_3, IODINE I 124 GIRENTUXIMAB PHASE_2, SULTHIAME PHASE_4, ETHOXZOLAMIDE WITHDRAWAL. UniProt: cell membrane (microvillus membrane), so antibody/imaging accessible. Tumour-up (TCGA log2FC 9.712). DepMap: ccRCC lines not dependent (mean effect 0.051, selectivity 0.031), so CA9 is a surface-antigen/biomarker case rather than a dependency target.

Convergence rank 3 (score 4.2143). Open Targets association score 0.0572, rank 955 of 1998 (weak prior association). Tractability: AB Advanced Clinical, OC Advanced Clinical. Drugs: CUSATUZUMAB PHASE_2, VORSETUZUMAB PHASE_1, VORSETUZUMAB MAFODOTIN PHASE_1, MDX-1411 PHASE_1. Cell membrane protein (UniProt). Tumour-up (TCGA log2FC 7.09, protein log2FC 2.421). DepMap non-dependent (mean effect 0.251), so an antibody/ADC/cell-therapy surface target, not a lineage dependency.

Convergence rank 7 (score 3.9643). Tumour-up (TCGA log2FC 4.685, protein log2FC 2.709) with purity-robust signal; TCGA Cox log HR 0.301 (adjusted p 0.00479), so higher expression tracks worse survival. Open Targets association score 0.0598, rank 940 of 1998. No drugs listed; predicted tractability only. Cytoplasmic methyltransferase (SAM consumption, H3K27me3 hypomethylation). DepMap mean effect 0.316, selectivity -0.075: no ccRCC dependency. Prognostic biomarker/mechanism candidate, untested target.

Convergence rank 5 (score 4.1052); top target-profile score 4.1314. Open Targets association score 0.4049 (genetic association 0.519), among the top 25 ccRCC associations. Tumour-up (TCGA log2FC 3.989, protein log2FC 1.837). Cell membrane/caveola (UniProt). No drugs returned, only predicted tractability. DepMap non-dependent (mean effect 0.002, selectivity -0.021), so a tractable-but-untested surface candidate with weak dependency support.

Convergence rank 2 (score 4.2206); biomarker profile 4.3755. Down in tumour (TCGA log2FC -4.741, protein log2FC -2.273). Better survival with higher expression (Cox log HR -0.358, adjusted p 0.000023). Open Targets association score 0.0701, rank 908 of 1998. No drugs. Loss-of-expression proximal-tubule marker, not a target.

Convergence rank 4 (score 4.1667); biomarker profile 4.3045. Strongly down in tumour (TCGA log2FC -6.154, protein log2FC -2.264); Cox log HR -0.402 (adjusted p 0.0000433). Open Targets association score 0.0662, rank 916 of 1998. Drugs listed: PROBENECID PHASE_4, PRATOSARTAN PHASE_3 (transporter substrates/inhibitors, not ccRCC therapies). Proximal-tubule loss biomarker.

Convergence rank 6 (score 4.0695). Open Targets association score 0.4532 (genetic association 0.7338), in the Open Targets top 25. Down in tumour (TCGA log2FC -3.721, protein log2FC -1.235). No drugs. DepMap non-dependent (mean effect 0.143). Association/biomarker-only gene.

Established ccRCC target (HIF-2alpha). Open Targets association score 0.4871, rank 9 of 1998. Drug: BELZUTIFAN APPROVAL. DepMap: ccRCC mean effect -0.143 vs other 0.157, selectivity 0.3, fraction of ccRCC lines dependent 0.208, adjusted p 0.061, not common essential. Selective but partial dependency, consistent with benefit in a VHL-defined subset. Pathways include HIF regulation and PD-L1 transcription.

Established ccRCC pathway target. Open Targets association score 0.525. Drugs include RIDAFOROLIMUS APPROVAL and many ATP-competitive/PI3K-mTOR inhibitors (for example GEDATOLISIB PHASE_3, DACTOLISIB PHASE_3). DepMap: ccRCC mean effect -1.52, selectivity 0.354, fraction dependent 1.0, adjusted p 0.011, but common essential true, so there is a systemic toxicity risk and a narrow therapeutic window.

Top-2 Open Targets association (score 0.6348). Driver status: mutated in 185 of 511 tumours (frequency 0.362), adjusted p 4.59e-239, recurrent. Tumour-suppressor, so a prognostic/stratification marker and synthetic-lethality context, not a direct inhibitor target.

Top Open Targets association (score 0.6466). Driver status: mutated in 247 of 511 tumours (frequency 0.483), adjusted p 0.0, recurrent. VHL loss stabilises HIF-2alpha, which underlies the EPAS1/belzutifan rationale and CA9 induction.

caveats: CA9 and CD70 DepMap results had null evidence ids; values quoted come from the convergence_ranking row only.
STRING and further genes (for example UMOD, FABP1, MT1G, ABAT) were not examined within the call budget; the ranking output was truncated to the top 12 rows.
Most top-ranked genes are tumour-down tubule markers that make good biomarkers but not targets.
Drug stages are reported as returned by Open Targets and include non-oncology uses (for example SULTHIAME, PROBENECID).
